decision: Re-establish the stock control with the first immutable complete GLM-4.7-Flash checkpoint before testing any optimization.

causal_hypothesis.primary: Adding the four weight shards absent from the previously pinned upstream commit is sufficient to produce a valid complete-checkpoint stock run, materially improve the frozen absolute quality screen, and retain the fixed 8K/1K service SLO on one H100.
causal_hypothesis.expected_direction: Quality improves substantially from the malformed 44-shard result; throughput remains in the same broad range because the runtime already instantiated and executed all configured layers.
causal_hypothesis.falsification_value: A complete, hash-verified checkpoint that still fails the frozen quality screen or cannot fit the same H100 rejects missing shards as a sufficient explanation and prevents quality-adjusted economic claims.

stock_control.historical_negative_control: v9 used revision 75fce703a93da3705c4cf8d3caadbac1d1072c78, loaded only 44 of 48 shards, and is invalid for intended-model quality or economics.
stock_control.candidate_change_only: model revision changes to the first complete upstream commit and model delivery changes to a locally verified stream; runtime, hardware, workload, seeds, serving policy, and gates remain fixed

model.delivery: all files are staged on the coordinator, SHA-256 verified against the official blobs=true API, streamed to the VM before container launch, and rehashed inside the container

workload_geometry.fixed_8k_1k_c1: 4 measured requests at concurrency 1, exactly 8192 input and 1024 output tokens each, after one warmup
workload_geometry.fixed_8k_1k_c8: 16 measured requests at concurrency 8, exactly 8192 input and 1024 output tokens each, after four warmups
workload_geometry.quality: unchanged complete 32K reasoning-off development capture and frozen self-score
workload_geometry.profiler: one 8192-input/128-output batch-one trace after the fixed sequence

quality_gate.absolute: all existing strict schema, formatting, task, and teacher-forced NLL thresholds must pass; NLL ceiling remains 2.0
quality_gate.claim_boundary: A quality failure can still preserve diagnostic throughput evidence, but cannot support quality-adjusted cost or promotion.

predictions.complete_checkpoint_load: passes within 900 seconds after local transfer
predictions.quality: teacher-forced NLL falls materially below 7.7076; full absolute screen may still expose independent prompt or formatting defects
predictions.peak_vram: higher than v9 by approximately the four added BF16 shards, but below 80GB
predictions.business: no cost win is predicted or claimable from this corrective control

budget.limitations: Public IPv4 and egress are excluded; provider invoice is pending. The run must stop if the reconstructed cap would be exceeded.

host: summary with full-VM and disk cost
artifact_contract.cleanup: retrieve and hash evidence before deletion; verify instance GET not-found and zero experiment-named instances/disks

falsification_rules.checkpoint: Any shard-count, byte-count, or SHA-256 mismatch invalidates the run before model load.
falsification_rules.compatibility: A complete checkpoint OOM or deterministic load failure falsifies one-H100 deployability at this geometry.
falsification_rules.quality: Failure of the unchanged absolute screen rejects missing shards as a sufficient correction.
falsification_rules.service: Any fixed sequence SLO failure rejects the stock service point.
falsification_rules.repeat: Do not repeat an identical placement or delivery failure.
falsification_rules.business: Do not compare cost to Fireworks or Baseten without a valid complete-checkpoint quality pass and matched provider workload/SLO evidence.

adaptive_admission.reason: A valid complete-checkpoint control must exist before spending on speculative decoding or representation candidates.
